content: Go stdlib crypto/tls fully covers TLS 1.2/1.3 client+server incl. certificate-based mutual auth needed for OpenVPN control channel; tls.Server(net.Conn, *tls.Config) works over any custom net.Conn including a hand-rolled framing layer. No gaps for the TLS handshake itself; the gap is OpenVPN's own post-handshake Key Method 2 PRF (see tls1-prf finding), which is NOT part of crypto/tls's public API.
